lines.text: Moses asks his father-in-law Jethro to let him return to Egypt, and the LORD tells him to go back.
Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads for Egypt with the staff of God.
The LORD says Israel is His firstborn son, and He will send darkness over all Egypt.
At a well in Midian, the LORD is about to kill Moses, but Zipporah circumcises her son.

wrong_details.true: a lodging place along the way

lines.text: Aaron meets Moses at the mountain of God, and the people believe when Aaron speaks and Moses performs the signs.
